name: Like Shattered Glass
source:
"The job was supposed to be simple. Drive the truck to the pickup spot, unload the goods, and drive back. Only Evil Batlet could turn a drop-off into a shootout and crash their truck into a tree."

Aging criminal Zoomer stitches Evil's wounds in an empty warehouse. The two get closer than he wants.

[From [url=https://arbitrrrary.itch.io/like-shattered-glass]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“这项工作本来应该很简单。把卡车开到取货点，卸下货物，然后开车回来。只有邪恶的蝙蝠能把下车变成枪战，然后把卡车撞到树上。”

年迈的罪犯佐默在空荡荡的仓库里缝合了邪恶的伤口。两人的距离比他想要的还要近。

[来自[url=https://arbitrrrary.itch.io/like-shattered-glass]Itch.io[/url]]
